name: Enemy Camp
description: Sneak: AGI − (Lvl + 1) (Fail: Encounter; Flee forfeits Loot). Loot: DEX − Lvl×2 (Draw Treasure ≤ Lvl).
flavorText: You wander into an enemy camp and spot hostiles ahead. Perform an AGI Sneak Check (AGI − (Terrain Lvl + 1)) to slip past unnoticed; on failure, fight them as an Encounter (fleeing forfeits treasure). After sneaking past or winning, perform a DEX Treasure Discovery Check (DEX − Terrain Lvl × 2) to draw from the Treasure Deck until you find an item with Lvl ≤ Terrain Lvl (higher-level cards are discarded).

name: Merchant
description: Draws the top 2 Treasure cards and offers them at double your DISC (rounded up). Purchase if Gold allows, or decline and leave.
flavorText: A traveling peddler emerges from the mist with rare wares. Draws the top 2 cards from the Treasure Deck and offers them at double your Charisma DISC (rounded up). Purchase what you can afford or decline and continue your journey.

name: Sanctuary
description: A peaceful haven along the path. Rest for free to restore your HP to full.
flavorText: Sunlight pierces the canopy over an ancient moss-draped spring. Here, weary travelers may rest in safety and mend all wounds without spending a single coin.

name: Ambush
description: Triggers a terrain-level Encounter immediately, but the enemies act first before your first turn.
flavorText: Shadows burst from the undergrowth before you can draw your weapon. Fight an Encounter for this terrain, with hostiles taking the opening turn.

name: Magical Chest
description: Force Open (STR − 3−2×Lvl), Lockpick (DEX − 3−2×Lvl), Remove Seal (INT − 1−2×Lvl), or Abandon. Success: top Treasure card. Fail: item destroyed & 3 DMG.
flavorText: An arcane-sealed coffer pulses with volatile mana. Crack it with brute strength, deft lockpicking, or dispelling magic—or walk away. Failure detonates the ward, destroying the treasure inside and dealing 3 damage.

name: Trapped Chest
description: Force Open (STR − 3−2×Lvl), Lockpick (DEX − 1−2×Lvl), or Abandon. Success: top Treasure card. Fail: item destroyed & 3 DMG.
flavorText: A heavy ironbound chest rigged with hair-trigger needles. Nimble fingers can disarm it easily, or brute force can pry it open—at the risk of a 3-damage blast that ruins the prize.

name: Gold Stash
description: Roll 1d6 to claim hidden coin: 1–3 grants 10 Gold, 4–5 grants 20 Gold, and 6 grants 30 Gold.
flavorText: Beneath gnarled roots lies a forgotten traveler’s coffer gleaming with stamped sovereigns. Roll 1d6 to see how much coin remains intact.

name: Spring Trap
description: Roll a MACG-3D6™ AGI − (1 + 2×Lvl) check. Succeed to avoid harm; fail to suffer 4 direct damage.
flavorText: A taut wire snaps underfoot! React in a split second with an AGI check (AGI − 1 − 2×Lvl) to leap clear, or take 4 direct damage from the concealed spikes.
